            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))

                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)

                    key=lambda color: sum(x for col, cells in objects if col == color for _, x in cells)
                    / sum(len(cells) for col, cells in objects if col == color))

            miny = min(y for y, x in cells)
            minx = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxx = max(x for y, x in cells)
            width = maxx - minx + 1
            x0 = lane_left + max(0, (lane_width - width) // 2)
            # Stack the components at the bottom while preserving their ordering.
            y0 = h - 1 - (max(y for y, x in cells) - miny)
            while y0 >= 0:

                if all(0 <= x < w and out[y][x] == 0 for y, x in shifted):
